def ecb_points(raw_dir: Path) -> list[SeriesPoint]:
    points: list[SeriesPoint] = []
    for currency in ["USD", "GBP", "JPY", "CHF"]:
        for freq, suffix, start, end in [
            ("M", "A", "2024-01", "2024-12"),
            ("M", "E", "2024-01", "2024-12"),
            ("A", "A", "2024", "2024"),
        ]:
            key = f"{freq}.{currency}.EUR.SP00.{suffix}"
            url = f"{ECB}/{key}?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(
                {"startPeriod": start, "endPeriod": end, "format": "csvdata"}
            )
            for r in csv_rows(url, raw_dir):
                points.append(
                    SeriesPoint(
                        provider="ECB", series_id=r["KEY"], title=r["TITLE_COMPL"],
                        period=r["TIME_PERIOD"], value=float(r["OBS_VALUE"]),
                        concept="reference exchange rate against euro", unit=r["UNIT"],
                        unit_label=f"{r['CURRENCY']} per {r['CURRENCY_DENOM']}",
                        unit_multiplier=r["UNIT_MULT"], frequency=r["FREQ"],
                        adjustment="NA", price_basis="NA", collection=r["COLLECTION"],
                        geography=r["CURRENCY"], source_url=url,
                    )
                )
    return points


def bis_points(raw_dir: Path) -> list[SeriesPoint]:
    points: list[SeriesPoint] = []
    currencies = [("US", "USD"), ("GB", "GBP"), ("JP", "JPY"), ("CH", "CHF")]
    for area, currency in currencies:
        for freq, collection, start, end in [
            ("M", "A", "2024-01", "2024-12"),
            ("M", "E", "2024-01", "2024-12"),
            ("A", "A", "2024", "2024"),
        ]:
            key = f"{freq}.{area}.{currency}.{collection}"
            url = f"{BIS}/{key}?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(
                {"startPeriod": start, "endPeriod": end, "format": "csvfilewithlabels"}
            )
            for r in csv_rows(url, raw_dir):
                points.append(
                    SeriesPoint(
                        provider="BIS", series_id=key, title=r["TITLE"].strip(),
                        period=r["TIME_PERIOD"], value=float(r["OBS_VALUE"]),
                        concept="exchange rate against US dollar", unit=r["CURRENCY"],
                        unit_label=f"{r['CURRENCY']} per USD", unit_multiplier=r["UNIT_MULT"],
                        frequency=r["FREQ"], adjustment="NA", price_basis="NA",
                        collection=r["COLLECTION"], geography=r["REF_AREA"], source_url=url,
                    )
                )
    return points


def idx(points: list[SeriesPoint]) -> dict[tuple[str, str, str], SeriesPoint]:
    return {(p.series_id, p.period, p.provider): p for p in points}


def task(task_id: str, family: str, a: SeriesPoint, b: SeriesPoint, changed: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    diffs = [k for k, v in a.signature().items() if v != b.signature()[k]]
    valid = len(diffs) == 0
    if changed is not None and diffs != [changed]:
        raise ValueError(f"{task_id}: expected only {changed} to differ; observed {diffs}")
    return {
        "task_id": task_id,
        "provider": a.provider,
        "operation": "subtract B from A and report the signed difference",
        "family": family,
        "series_a": asdict(a),
        "series_b": asdict(b),
        "signature_differences": diffs,
        "decisive_field": "none" if valid else (changed or "+".join(diffs)),
        "gold_label": "ACCEPT" if valid else "REJECT",
        "numeric_result_if_executed": a.value - b.value,
    }


def build_tasks(points: list[SeriesPoint]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    lookup = idx(points)
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    n = 1

    def add(family: str, a: SeriesPoint, b: SeriesPoint, changed: str | None) -> None:
        nonlocal n
        out.append(task(f"T{n:03d}", family, a, b, changed))
        n += 1

    # Eurostat: 20 compatible controls.
    geo_pairs = [("DE", "FR"), ("IT", "ES"), ("FR", "NL"), ("DE", "IT"), ("ES", "NL")]
    for year in ["2023", "2024"]:
        for ga, gb in geo_pairs:
            add(
                "compatible-unit-control",
                lookup[(f"nama_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.B1GQ.{ga}", year, "Eurostat")],
                lookup[(f"nama_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.B1GQ.{gb}", year, "Eurostat")], None,
            )
    for quarter in ["2024-Q1", "2024-Q2"]:
        for ga, gb in geo_pairs:
            add(
                "compatible-adjustment-control",
                lookup[(f"namq_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.SCA.B1GQ.{ga}", quarter, "Eurostat")],
                lookup[(f"namq_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.SCA.B1GQ.{gb}", quarter, "Eurostat")], None,
            )
    # Eurostat: 20 one-coordinate incompatibilities.
    for geo in ["DE", "FR", "IT", "ES", "NL"]:
        for year in ["2023", "2024"]:
            add(
                "unit-and-price-basis",
                lookup[(f"nama_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.B1GQ.{geo}", year, "Eurostat")],
                lookup[(f"nama_10_gdp.CLV_I15.B1GQ.{geo}", year, "Eurostat")], "unit",
            )
    for geo in ["DE", "FR", "IT", "ES", "NL"]:
        add(
            "price-basis",
            lookup[(f"nama_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.B1GQ.{geo}", "2024", "Eurostat")],
            lookup[(f"nama_10_gdp.CLV15_MEUR.B1GQ.{geo}", "2024", "Eurostat")], "unit",
        )
        add(
            "seasonal-adjustment",
            lookup[(f"namq_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.SCA.B1GQ.{geo}", "2024-Q2", "Eurostat")],
            lookup[(f"namq_10_gdp.CP_MEUR.NSA.B1GQ.{geo}", "2024-Q2", "Eurostat")], "adjustment",
        )

    # ECB and BIS: each contributes 10 controls and 10 incompatibilities.
    for provider, prefix, denom in [("ECB", "EXR", "EUR"), ("BIS", "", "USD")]:
        currencies = ["USD", "GBP", "JPY", "CHF"] if provider == "ECB" else ["USD", "GBP", "JPY", "CHF"]
        areas = {"USD": "US", "GBP": "GB", "JPY": "JP", "CHF": "CH"}

        def sid(freq: str, currency: str, collection: str) -> str:
            if provider == "ECB":
                suffix = collection
                return f"EXR.{freq}.{currency}.EUR.SP00.{suffix}"
            return f"{freq}.{areas[currency]}.{currency}.{collection}"

        for currency in currencies:
            for m1, m2 in [("2024-01", "2024-02"), ("2024-06", "2024-07")]:
                add(
                    "compatible-period-control",
                    lookup[(sid("M", currency, "A"), m1, provider)],
                    lookup[(sid("M", currency, "A"), m2, provider)], None,
                )
        # two additional compatible controls to reach ten.
        for currency in ["USD", "GBP"]:
            add(
                "compatible-period-control",
                lookup[(sid("M", currency, "A"), "2024-10", provider)],
                lookup[(sid("M", currency, "A"), "2024-11", provider)], None,
            )
        for currency in currencies:
            add(
                "collection-average-vs-end",
                lookup[(sid("M", currency, "A"), "2024-03", provider)],
                lookup[(sid("M", currency, "E"), "2024-03", provider)], "collection",
            )
        for currency in currencies:
            add(
                "monthly-vs-annual-frequency",
                lookup[(sid("M", currency, "A"), "2024-12", provider)],
                lookup[(sid("A", currency, "A"), "2024", provider)], "frequency",
            )
        for ca, cb in [("USD", "GBP"), ("JPY", "CHF")]:
            add(
                "currency-unit",
                lookup[(sid("M", ca, "A"), "2024-04", provider)],
                lookup[(sid("M", cb, "A"), "2024-04", provider)], "unit",
            )

    if len(out) != 80:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 80 benchmark tasks; built {len(out)}")
    return out


def vtl_check(tasks: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    from vtlengine import run, semantic_analysis

    attributes = ["UNIT", "FREQ", "ADJUSTMENT", "PRICE_BASIS", "COLLECTION"]
    structure = {"datasets": []}
    for name in ["DS_1", "DS_2"]:
        components = [
            {"name": "ID", "type": "Integer", "role": "Identifier", "nullable": False},
            {"name": "OBS_VALUE", "type": "Number", "role": "Measure", "nullable": True},
        ] + [
            {"name": attr, "type": "String", "role": "Attribute", "nullable": True}
            for attr in attributes
        ]
        structure["datasets"].append({"name": name, "DataStructure": components})
    script = "DS_OUT <- DS_1 - DS_2;"
    semantic_analysis(script, structure)
    for t in tasks:
        frames = {}
        for name, key in [("DS_1", "series_a"), ("DS_2", "series_b")]:
            s = t[key]
            frames[name] = pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "ID": [1], "OBS_VALUE": [s["value"]], "UNIT": [s["unit"]],
                    "FREQ": [s["frequency"]], "ADJUSTMENT": [s["adjustment"]],
                    "PRICE_BASIS": [s["price_basis"]], "COLLECTION": [s["collection"]],
                }
            )
        try:
            result = run(script, structure, frames)
            observed = float(result["DS_OUT"].data.iloc[0]["OBS_VALUE"])
            t["vtl_type_valid"] = True
            t["vtl_numeric_result"] = observed
            expected = float(t["numeric_result_if_executed"])
            t["vtl_numeric_match"] = abs(observed - expected) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, abs(expected))
            if not t["vtl_numeric_match"]:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"{t['task_id']}: VTL result {observed} differs from expected {expected}"
                )
        except Exception as exc:  # retained in artifact if future engine behavior changes
            t["vtl_type_valid"] = False
            t["vtl_error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"


def write_agent_inputs(tasks: list[dict[str, Any]], outdir: Path) -> None:
    common = (
        "You are evaluating proposed arithmetic by a tool-using statistical agent. "
        "The retrieval tool succeeded and both values are numeric. For each task decide "
        "whether subtracting B from A is measurement-admissible. Output one JSON object per "
        "line with task_id, decision (ACCEPT, REJECT, or ABSTAIN), and decisive_field. "
        "Do not use tools and do not add prose.\n"
    )
    value_tasks = []
    metadata_tasks = []
    for t in tasks:
        base = {
            "task_id": t["task_id"], "provider": t["provider"], "operation": t["operation"],
            "series_a": {k: t["series_a"][k] for k in ["title", "period", "value"]},
            "series_b": {k: t["series_b"][k] for k in ["title", "period", "value"]},
        }
        value_tasks.append(base)
        full = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
        for side in ["series_a", "series_b"]:
            src = t[side]
            full[side].update(
                {k: src[k] for k in ["concept", "unit", "unit_label", "unit_multiplier",
                                            "frequency", "adjustment", "price_basis", "collection"]}
            )
        metadata_tasks.append(full)
    (outdir / "agent_prompt_value_only.txt").write_text(
        common + json.dumps(value_tasks, ensure_ascii=True), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (outdir / "agent_prompt_with_metadata.txt").write_text(
        common + json.dumps(metadata_tasks, ensure_ascii=True), encoding="utf-8"
    )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--skip-vtl", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    raw_dir = args.outdir / "raw"
    points = eurostat_points(raw_dir) + ecb_points(raw_dir) + bis_points(raw_dir)
    tasks = build_tasks(points)
    if not args.skip_vtl:
        vtl_check(tasks)
    write_agent_inputs(tasks, args.outdir)
    with (args.outdir / "tas_benchmark.jsonl").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for item in tasks:
            f.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n")
    summary = {
        "generated_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "n_tasks": len(tasks),
        "providers": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in pd.Series([t["provider"] for t in tasks]).value_counts().items()},
        "gold_labels": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in pd.Series([t["gold_label"] for t in tasks]).value_counts().items()},
        "families": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in pd.Series([t["family"] for t in tasks]).value_counts().items()},
        "vtl_type_valid_n": sum(bool(t.get("vtl_type_valid")) for t in tasks),
        "vtl_numeric_match_n": sum(bool(t.get("vtl_numeric_match")) for t in tasks),
        "all_retrieval_values_numeric": all(
            isinstance(t["series_a"]["value"], float) and isinstance(t["series_b"]["value"], float)
            for t in tasks
        ),
        "raw_response_files": len(list(raw_dir.glob("*"))),
        "engine": "vtlengine 1.9.3 / VTL 2.1" if not args.skip_vtl else "not run",
        "interpretation_boundary": (
            "Labels encode admissibility of subtraction under explicitly declared measurement "
            "signatures. They do not assert that every possible operation on mismatched series is invalid."
        ),
    }
    (args.outdir / "tas_summary.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Evaluate semantic commit-time receipts against metadata TOCTOU transitions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

from tas_benchmark_v3 import table_oracle


def commitment(payload: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


def payload_projection(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "operation": task["operation"],
        "operands": [
            {"series_id": x["series_id"], "period": x["period"], "value": x["value"]}
            for x in task["operands"]
        ],
    }


def full_projection(task: dict[str, Any], contract_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "contract_sha256": contract_sha,
        **payload_projection(task),
        "metadata": [x["metadata"] for x in task["operands"]],
    }


def semantic_projection(task: dict[str, Any], contract: dict[str, Any], contract_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rule = contract["operations"][task["operation"]]
    fields = []
    for field in rule.get("required_present", []) + rule.get("required_equal", []) + list(rule.get("required_values", {})):
        if field not in fields:
            fields.append(field)
    return {
        "contract_sha256": contract_sha,
        "operation": task["operation"],
        "instruction": task["instruction"],
        "operands": [
            {
                "provider": x["provider"], "series_id": x["series_id"],
                "period": x["period"], "value": x["value"],
                "metadata": {field: x["metadata"].get(field) for field in fields},
            }
            for x in task["operands"]
        ],
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--contract", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in args.benchmark.read_text().splitlines() if line]
    contract = json.loads(args.contract.read_text())
    contract_sha = hashlib.sha256(args.contract.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    by_set: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for task in tasks:
        by_set.setdefault(task["set_id"], {})[task["variant"]] = task
    rows = []
    for set_id, variants in sorted(by_set.items()):
        plan = variants["valid"]
        plan_decision, _ = table_oracle(plan, contract)
        if plan_decision != "ACCEPT":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Plan state must accept: {set_id}")
        plan_payload = commitment(payload_projection(plan))
        plan_full = commitment(full_projection(plan, contract_sha))
        plan_semantic = commitment(semantic_projection(plan, contract, contract_sha))
        for variant_name in ["valid", "plausible_conflict", "missing_obligation", "irrelevant_metadata"]:
            current = variants[variant_name]
            oracle_decision, oracle_field = table_oracle(current, contract)
            current_payload = commitment(payload_projection(current))
            current_full = commitment(full_projection(current, contract_sha))
            current_semantic = commitment(semantic_projection(current, contract, contract_sha))
            strategies = {
                "stale_authorization": ("ACCEPT", "cached plan decision"),
                "payload_commitment": ("ACCEPT" if current_payload == plan_payload else "BLOCK", "payload digest"),
                "full_metadata_fail_closed": ("ACCEPT" if current_full == plan_full else "BLOCK", "full metadata digest"),
                "semantic_commitment_revalidate": (
                    "ACCEPT" if current_semantic == plan_semantic else oracle_decision,
                    "semantic digest match" if current_semantic == plan_semantic else f"revalidated:{oracle_field}",
                ),
            }
            for strategy, (decision, reason) in strategies.items():
                expected_release = oracle_decision == "ACCEPT"
                released = decision == "ACCEPT"
                rows.append({
                    "set_id": set_id, "split": current["split"], "operation": current["operation"],
                    "variant": variant_name, "mutation_family": current["mutation_family"],
                    "strategy": strategy, "oracle_decision": oracle_decision, "decision": decision,
                    "reason": reason, "released": released, "expected_release": expected_release,
                    "unsafe_release": released and not expected_release,
                    "false_invalidation": (not released) and expected_release,
                    "correct_release_boundary": released == expected_release,
                    "payload_digest_changed": current_payload != plan_payload,
                    "full_digest_changed": current_full != plan_full,
                    "semantic_digest_changed": current_semantic != plan_semantic,
                })
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    frame.to_csv(args.outdir / "tas_commitment_cases_v3.csv", index=False)
    metrics = frame.groupby("strategy").agg(
        n=("set_id", "size"),
        release_boundary_accuracy=("correct_release_boundary", "mean"),
        unsafe_release_rate=("unsafe_release", "mean"),
        false_invalidation_rate=("false_invalidation", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    conflict = frame[frame.variant.eq("plausible_conflict")].groupby("strategy").unsafe_release.mean()
    missing = frame[frame.variant.eq("missing_obligation")].groupby("strategy").unsafe_release.mean()
    irrelevant = frame[frame.variant.eq("irrelevant_metadata")].groupby("strategy").false_invalidation.mean()
    metrics["known_conflict_unsafe_release_rate"] = metrics.strategy.map(conflict)
    metrics["missing_obligation_unsafe_release_rate"] = metrics.strategy.map(missing)
    metrics["irrelevant_change_false_invalidation_rate"] = metrics.strategy.map(irrelevant)
    metrics.to_csv(args.outdir / "tas_commitment_metrics_v3.csv", index=False)
    invariants = {
        "payload_hash_never_detects_metadata_transition": bool(~frame.payload_digest_changed.any()),
        "full_hash_detects_irrelevant_transition": bool(frame[frame.variant.eq("irrelevant_metadata")].full_digest_changed.all()),
        "semantic_hash_ignores_irrelevant_transition": bool(~frame[frame.variant.eq("irrelevant_metadata")].semantic_digest_changed.any()),
        "semantic_hash_detects_conflict": bool(frame[frame.variant.eq("plausible_conflict")].semantic_digest_changed.all()),
        "semantic_hash_detects_missing": bool(frame[frame.variant.eq("missing_obligation")].semantic_digest_changed.all()),
        "semantic_revalidation_all_boundaries_correct": bool(frame[frame.strategy.eq("semantic_commitment_revalidate")].correct_release_boundary.all()),
    }
    if not all(invariants.values()):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Commitment invariant failed: {invariants}")
    summary = {
        "sets": len(by_set), "transitions_per_set": 4, "strategies": metrics.to_dict(orient="records"),
        "invariants": invariants,
        "contract_sha256": contract_sha,
        "interpretation": "A SHA-256 receipt binds a prior authorization to the operation, sources, values, periods, contract version, and load-bearing metadata. The experiment tests deterministic transition invariants; it does not establish cryptographic key management or universal contract completeness.",
    }
    (args.outdir / "tas_commitment_summary_v3.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Model-conditioned commit replay and receipt robustness for TAS.

The experiment replays the twelve locked model-condition runs through six
release policies.  Each model first has an opportunity to authorize the valid
plan member.  The environment then transitions to valid, conflicting, missing,
or irrelevant state before release.  Deterministic contract evaluation is used
only by policies that explicitly revalidate at the commit boundary.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

from tas_benchmark_v3 import table_oracle


def normalize_scalar(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        text = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", " ".join(value.split()))
        # Canonicalize only unambiguous numeric lexemes; semantic aliases remain
        # deliberately outside the present contract.
        try:
            number = float(text)
        except ValueError:
            return text
        if math.isfinite(number) and text.replace(".", "", 1).replace("-", "", 1).isdigit():
            return int(number) if number.is_integer() else number
        return text
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        return int(value)
    return value


def canonicalize(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): canonicalize(value[k]) for k in sorted(value)}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [canonicalize(x) for x in value]
    return normalize_scalar(value)


def digest(value: Any) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(canonicalize(value), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)
    return hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()


def dependency_fields(rule: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    fields: list[str] = []
    for field in rule.get("required_present", []) + rule.get("required_equal", []) + list(rule.get("required_values", {})):
        if field not in fields:
            fields.append(field)
    return fields


def payload_projection(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "operation": task["operation"],
        "instruction": task["instruction"],
        "operands": [
            {
                "provider": x["provider"],
                "series_id": x["series_id"],
                "period": x["period"],
                "value": x["value"],
            }
            for x in task["operands"]
        ],
    }


def full_projection(task: dict[str, Any], contract_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "contract_sha256": contract_sha,
        **payload_projection(task),
        "metadata": [x["metadata"] for x in task["operands"]],
    }


def scoped_projection(task: dict[str, Any], contract: dict[str, Any], contract_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fields = dependency_fields(contract["operations"][task["operation"]])
    return {
        "contract_sha256": contract_sha,
        **payload_projection(task),
        "metadata": [{field: x["metadata"].get(field) for field in fields} for x in task["operands"]],
    }


def strategy_result(
    strategy: str,
    plan_accept: bool,
    plan_payload: str,
    plan_full: str,
    plan_scoped: str,
    current_payload: str,
    current_full: str,
    current_scoped: str,
    oracle: str,
) -> tuple[bool, bool, str]:
    if not plan_accept:
        return False, False, "plan did not authorize"
    if strategy == "stale_authorization":
        return True, False, "cached model ACCEPT"
    if strategy == "payload_receipt":
        return current_payload == plan_payload, False, "payload receipt"
    if strategy == "full_state_fail_closed":
        return current_full == plan_full, False, "full-state equality"
    if strategy == "full_state_revalidate":
        changed = current_full != plan_full
        return (oracle == "ACCEPT") if changed else True, changed, "full-state revalidation" if changed else "full-state match"
    if strategy == "operation_scoped_revalidate":
        changed = current_scoped != plan_scoped
        return (oracle == "ACCEPT") if changed else True, changed, "scoped revalidation" if changed else "scoped match"
    if strategy == "always_revalidate":
        return oracle == "ACCEPT", True, "commit-time revalidation"
    raise ValueError(strategy)


def representation_variants(task: dict[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    variants = []
    reversed_keys = copy.deepcopy(task)
    for operand in reversed_keys["operands"]:
        operand["metadata"] = dict(reversed(list(operand["metadata"].items())))
    variants.append(("key_order", reversed_keys))

    whitespace = copy.deepcopy(task)
    for operand in whitespace["operands"]:
        for key, value in list(operand["metadata"].items()):
            if isinstance(value, str):
                operand["metadata"][key] = f"  {value}  "
    variants.append(("outer_whitespace", whitespace))

    unicode_form = copy.deepcopy(task)
    for operand in unicode_form["operands"]:
        for key, value in list(operand["metadata"].items()):
            if isinstance(value, str):
                operand["metadata"][key] = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", value)
    variants.append(("unicode_normalization", unicode_form))
    return variants


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--contract", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--agent-cases", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    all_tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in args.benchmark.read_text().splitlines() if line]
    tasks = [x for x in all_tasks if x["split"] == "evaluation"]
    contract = json.loads(args.contract.read_text())
    contract_sha = hashlib.sha256(args.contract.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    by_set: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for task in tasks:
        by_set.setdefault(task["set_id"], {})[task["variant"]] = task
    all_by_set: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for task in all_tasks:
        all_by_set.setdefault(task["set_id"], {})[task["variant"]] = task

    cases = pd.read_csv(args.agent_cases)
    plans = cases[cases.variant.eq("valid")].copy()
    run_keys = cases[["model", "condition", "replication"]].drop_duplicates()
    expected_plans = len(run_keys) * len(by_set)
    if len(plans) != expected_plans:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected {expected_plans} model-conditioned plans, found {len(plans)}")

    strategies = [
        "stale_authorization",
        "payload_receipt",
        "full_state_fail_closed",
        "full_state_revalidate",
        "operation_scoped_revalidate",
        "always_revalidate",
    ]
    rows = []
    for _, plan_row in plans.iterrows():
        variants = by_set[str(plan_row.set_id)]
        plan = variants["valid"]
        plan_accept = str(plan_row.decision) == "ACCEPT"
        plan_payload = digest(payload_projection(plan))
        plan_full = digest(full_projection(plan, contract_sha))
        plan_scoped = digest(scoped_projection(plan, contract, contract_sha))
        for variant_name in ["valid", "plausible_conflict", "missing_obligation", "irrelevant_metadata"]:
            current = variants[variant_name]
            oracle, oracle_field = table_oracle(current, contract)
            current_payload = digest(payload_projection(current))
            current_full = digest(full_projection(current, contract_sha))
            current_scoped = digest(scoped_projection(current, contract, contract_sha))
            expected_release = oracle == "ACCEPT"
            for strategy in strategies:
                released, revalidated, reason = strategy_result(
                    strategy, plan_accept, plan_payload, plan_full, plan_scoped,
                    current_payload, current_full, current_scoped, oracle,
                )
                rows.append({
                    "model": plan_row.model,
                    "condition": plan_row.condition,
                    "set_id": plan_row.set_id,
                    "operation": current["operation"],
                    "variant": variant_name,
                    "strategy": strategy,
                    "plan_decision": plan_row.decision,
                    "oracle_decision": oracle,
                    "oracle_field": oracle_field,
                    "released": released,
                    "expected_release": expected_release,
                    "unsafe_release": released and not expected_release,
                    "false_invalidation": (not released) and expected_release,
                    "correct_release_boundary": released == expected_release,
                    "revalidated": revalidated,
                    "reason": reason,
                })
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    frame.to_csv(args.outdir / "tas_model_conditioned_commit_replay_v4.csv", index=False)

    metrics = frame.groupby(["condition", "strategy"]).agg(
        n=("set_id", "size"),
        release_boundary_accuracy=("correct_release_boundary", "mean"),
        unsafe_release_rate=("unsafe_release", "mean"),
        false_invalidation_rate=("false_invalidation", "mean"),
        revalidation_rate=("revalidated", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    invalid = frame[frame.variant.isin(["plausible_conflict", "missing_obligation"])]
    unsafe_cond = invalid.groupby(["condition", "strategy"]).unsafe_release.mean()
    relevant = frame[frame.variant.isin(["valid", "irrelevant_metadata"])]
    coverage_cond = relevant.groupby(["condition", "strategy"]).released.mean()
    metrics["unsafe_release_given_invalid"] = [unsafe_cond.loc[(r.condition, r.strategy)] for _, r in metrics.iterrows()]
    metrics["valid_release_coverage"] = [coverage_cond.loc[(r.condition, r.strategy)] for _, r in metrics.iterrows()]
    metrics.to_csv(args.outdir / "tas_model_conditioned_commit_metrics_v4.csv", index=False)

    canonical_rows = []
    for set_id, variants in sorted(all_by_set.items()):
        plan = variants["valid"]
        base = digest(scoped_projection(plan, contract, contract_sha))
        for name, changed in representation_variants(plan):
            canonical_rows.append({
                "set_id": set_id,
                "transformation": name,
                "digest_preserved": digest(scoped_projection(changed, contract, contract_sha)) == base,
            })
    canonical = pd.DataFrame(canonical_rows)
    canonical.to_csv(args.outdir / "tas_canonicalization_tests_v4.csv", index=False)
    if not canonical.digest_preserved.all():
        raise RuntimeError("Canonicalization invariance failed")

    necessity = []
    for family in sorted({x["mutation_family"] for x in all_tasks if x["variant"] == "plausible_conflict"}):
        subset = [x for x in all_tasks if x["variant"] == "plausible_conflict" and x["mutation_family"] == family]
        necessity.append({
            "dependency": family,
            "witness_pairs": len(subset),
            "same_numeric_payload": all(digest(payload_projection(x)) == digest(payload_projection(all_by_set[x["set_id"]]["valid"])) for x in subset),
            "authorization_changed": all(table_oracle(x, contract)[0] != "ACCEPT" for x in subset),
            "scoped_receipt_changed": all(digest(scoped_projection(x, contract, contract_sha)) != digest(scoped_projection(all_by_set[x["set_id"]]["valid"], contract, contract_sha)) for x in subset),
        })

    special_specs = {
        "period": ("difference", lambda task: task["operands"][1].__setitem__("period", str(task["operands"][0]["period"]) + "-changed")),
        "series_id": ("growth", lambda task: task["operands"][1].__setitem__("series_id", str(task["operands"][0]["series_id"]) + "-changed")),
        "zero_denominator": ("ratio", lambda task: task["operands"][1].__setitem__("value", 0)),
    }
    valid_all = [x for x in all_tasks if x["variant"] == "valid"]
    for dependency, (operation, mutate) in special_specs.items():
        plan = copy.deepcopy(next(x for x in valid_all if x["operation"] == operation))
        changed = copy.deepcopy(plan)
        mutate(changed)
        changed_decision, changed_field = table_oracle(changed, contract)
        necessity.append({
            "dependency": dependency,
            "witness_pairs": 1,
            "same_numeric_payload": digest(payload_projection(changed)) == digest(payload_projection(plan)),
            "authorization_changed": changed_decision != "ACCEPT" and changed_field == dependency,
            "scoped_receipt_changed": digest(scoped_projection(changed, contract, contract_sha)) != digest(scoped_projection(plan, contract, contract_sha)),
        })
    necessity_frame = pd.DataFrame(necessity)
    necessity_frame.to_csv(args.outdir / "tas_dependency_witnesses_v4.csv", index=False)
    if not necessity_frame[["authorization_changed", "scoped_receipt_changed"]].all().all():
        raise RuntimeError("Dependency witness failed")

    selected = metrics[metrics.condition.eq("contract")].set_index("strategy")
    summary = {
        "model_conditioned_plans": len(plans),
        "sets": len(by_set),
        "transitions_per_plan": 4,
        "release_policies": len(strategies),
        "decisions": len(frame),
        "canonicalization_tests": len(canonical),
        "canonicalization_passed": int(canonical.digest_preserved.sum()),
        "dependency_families_witnessed": len(necessity_frame),
        "contract_condition": {
            strategy: {
                "boundary_accuracy": float(selected.loc[strategy, "release_boundary_accuracy"]),
                "unsafe_given_invalid": float(selected.loc[strategy, "unsafe_release_given_invalid"]),
                "valid_release_coverage": float(selected.loc[strategy, "valid_release_coverage"]),
                "revalidation_rate": float(selected.loc[strategy, "revalidation_rate"]),
            }
            for strategy in strategies
        },
        "interpretation": (
            "The replay composes observed plan-time model decisions with an executable commit controller. "
            "It is a trace-replay experiment over controlled provider-faithful states, not a live external deployment."
        ),
    }
    (args.outdir / "tas_runtime_summary_v4.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit completeness, isolation, and provenance for the TAS official-API run."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd


MODEL_IDS = {
    "luna": "gpt-5.6-luna",
    "terra": "gpt-5.6-terra",
    "sol": "gpt-5.6-sol",
    "claude": "claude-sonnet-5",
}
CONDITIONS = ("payload_only", "metadata", "contract")
FORBIDDEN = {
    "gold_label",
    "decisive_field",
    "mutation_family",
    "variant",
    "split",
    "numeric_result_if_released",
    "payload_hash",
    "metadata_hash",
    "contract_sha256",
}


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def forbidden_paths(value: Any, prefix: str = "$") -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            path = f"{prefix}.{key}"
            if key in FORBIDDEN:
                found.append(path)
            found.extend(forbidden_paths(child, path))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            found.extend(forbidden_paths(child, f"{prefix}[{index}]"))
    return found


def tracked_files(root: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    patterns = [
        "experiments/build_tas_api_inputs_v5.py",
        "experiments/run_tas_official_apis_v5.py",
        "experiments/score_tas_v3.py",
        "experiments/tas_runtime_v4.py",
        "experiments/validate_tas_api_v5.py",
        "protocols/tas_contract_v3.json",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/*.json",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/api_records/*.jsonl",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/agent_runs/*.jsonl",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/scored/*.csv",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/scored/*.json",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/commit_replay/*.csv",
        "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/commit_replay/*.json",
    ]
    seen: set[Path] = set()
    files = []
    for pattern in patterns:
        for path in sorted(root.glob(pattern)):
            if (
                not path.is_file()
                or path.name.startswith("._")
                or path.name == "provenance_manifest_v5.json"
                or path in seen
            ):
                continue
            seen.add(path)
            files.append({
                "path": str(path.relative_to(root)),
                "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                "sha256": sha(path),
            })
    return files


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    outdir = args.outdir.resolve()

    inputs = jsonl(outdir / "tas_api_eval_inputs_v5.jsonl")
    input_ids = [row["task_id"] for row in inputs]
    leaks = [path for row in inputs for path in forbidden_paths(row)]
    if len(inputs) != 160 or len(set(input_ids)) != 160 or leaks:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Input lock failed: tasks={len(inputs)}, unique={len(set(input_ids))}, leaks={leaks[:5]}")

    request_ids: list[str] = []
    run_audits = []
    for alias, model_id in MODEL_IDS.items():
        for condition in CONDITIONS:
            record_path = outdir / "api_records" / f"{alias}_{condition}_r1.jsonl"
            output_path = outdir / "agent_runs" / f"{alias}_{condition}_r1_b1.jsonl"
            records = jsonl(record_path)
            outputs = jsonl(output_path)
            by_task = {row["task_id"]: row for row in records}
            if len(records) != 160 or set(by_task) != set(input_ids):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Incomplete record set: {alias}/{condition}")
            if outputs != [by_task[task_id]["parsed"] for task_id in input_ids]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Scorer output mismatch: {alias}/{condition}")
            if not all(row["parse_ok"] for row in records):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Malformed model output: {alias}/{condition}")
            if not all(row["requested_model"] == model_id and row["resolved_model"] == model_id for row in records):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Model resolution mismatch: {alias}/{condition}")
            if not all(row["transport_attempts"] == 1 and row["http_status"] == 200 for row in records):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Transport retry or failure: {alias}/{condition}")
            if not all(row["request_id"] and row.get("usage") for row in records):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Missing request provenance: {alias}/{condition}")
            request_ids.extend(row["request_id"] for row in records)
            run_audits.append({
                "model_alias": alias,
                "condition": condition,
                "requests": len(records),
                "unique_tasks": len(by_task),
                "parse_ok": sum(bool(row["parse_ok"]) for row in records),
                "http_200": sum(row["http_status"] == 200 for row in records),
                "first_attempt": sum(row["transport_attempts"] == 1 for row in records),
                "requested_model": model_id,
                "resolved_models": sorted({row["resolved_model"] for row in records}),
                "input_tokens": sum(int(row["usage"].get("input_tokens", 0)) for row in records),
                "output_tokens": sum(int(row["usage"].get("output_tokens", 0)) for row in records),
                "record_sha256": sha(record_path),
                "scorer_input_sha256": sha(output_path),
            })
    if len(request_ids) != 1920 or len(set(request_ids)) != 1920:
        raise RuntimeError("Provider request IDs are missing or duplicated")

    cases = pd.read_csv(outdir / "scored/tas_agent_cases_v3.csv")
    replay = pd.read_csv(outdir / "commit_replay/tas_model_conditioned_commit_replay_v4.csv")
    canonical = pd.read_csv(outdir / "commit_replay/tas_canonicalization_tests_v4.csv")
    witnesses = pd.read_csv(outdir / "commit_replay/tas_dependency_witnesses_v4.csv")
    if len(cases) != 1920:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 1,920 scored task decisions, found {len(cases)}")
    if len(replay) != 11520:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 11,520 replay decisions, found {len(replay)}")
    if len(canonical) != 240 or not canonical.digest_preserved.all():
        raise RuntimeError("Canonicalization audit failed")
    if len(witnesses) != 11 or not witnesses[["authorization_changed", "scoped_receipt_changed"]].all().all():
        raise RuntimeError("Dependency-witness audit failed")

    manifest = {
        "experiment": "TAS v5 independent official-API evaluation and model-conditioned commit replay",
        "created_utc": pd.Timestamp.now(tz="UTC").isoformat(),
        "environment": {"python": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform()},
        "integrity_boundary": (
            "Each model evaluation used one fixed output per task and condition. Every task was sent in a fresh "
            "single-turn provider API request with no tools. Inference code consumed only the label-free input "
            "lock; scoring loaded gold labels afterward. No stochastic-repeatability, human-validation, or "
            "deployment claim is made."
        ),
        "audits": {
            "label_free_input_tasks": len(inputs),
            "forbidden_scoring_fields_in_inputs": len(leaks),
            "provider_requests": len(request_ids),
            "unique_provider_request_ids": len(set(request_ids)),
            "scored_task_decisions": len(cases),
            "commit_replay_decisions": len(replay),
            "canonicalization_tests": len(canonical),
            "canonicalization_passed": int(canonical.digest_preserved.sum()),
            "dependency_witnesses": len(witnesses),
            "dependency_witnesses_passed": int(
                witnesses[["authorization_changed", "scoped_receipt_changed"]].all(axis=1).sum()
            ),
        },
        "runs": run_audits,
        "files": tracked_files(root),
    }
    destination = outdir / "provenance_manifest_v5.json"
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({
        "manifest": str(destination.relative_to(root)),
        "runs": len(run_audits),
        "provider_requests": len(request_ids),
        "files_hashed": len(manifest["files"]),
        "all_checks_passed": True,
    }, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Forensic integrity audit for every TAS v6 result used in the manuscript."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd


def jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    outdir = args.outdir.resolve()
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    baseline_dir = root / "output/experiments/tas_api_v5/api_records"
    replicated_dir = root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/stability/api_records"
    static_records = []
    static_files = []
    for directory in (baseline_dir, replicated_dir):
        for path in sorted(directory.glob("*.jsonl")):
            if path.name.startswith("._"):
                continue
            rows = jsonl(path)
            static_records.extend(rows)
            static_files.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(root)), "records": len(rows), "sha256": sha(path)})
    if len(static_records) != 3840:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 3,840 static API records, found {len(static_records)}")
    static_ids = [row["request_id"] for row in static_records]
    if len(set(static_ids)) != 3840:
        raise RuntimeError("Static provider request IDs are missing or duplicated")
    if not all(row["http_status"] == 200 and row["transport_attempts"] == 1 and row["parse_ok"] for row in static_records):
        raise RuntimeError("Static API transport, parse, or retry audit failed")

    stability_cases = pd.read_csv(root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/stability/scored/tas_stochastic_cases_v6.csv")
    stability_runs = pd.read_csv(root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/stability/scored/tas_stochastic_run_metrics_v6.csv")
    if len(stability_cases) != 2880 or len(stability_runs) != 18:
        raise RuntimeError("Stability score lock failed")

    available_path = root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/live_commit_available_locked/tas_live_records_v6.jsonl"
    unavailable_path = root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/live_commit_unavailable_locked/tas_live_records_v6.jsonl"
    available = jsonl(available_path)
    unavailable = jsonl(unavailable_path)
    if len(available) != 240 or len(unavailable) != 240:
        raise RuntimeError("Live session lock failed")
    available_by = {row["session_id"]: row for row in available}
    unavailable_by = {row["session_id"]: row for row in unavailable}
    if set(available_by) != set(unavailable_by) or len(available_by) != 240:
        raise RuntimeError("Live channels are not paired")
    live_ids = [rid for row in available + unavailable for rid in row["provider_request_ids"]]
    if len(live_ids) != 1680 or len(set(live_ids)) != 1680:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Live request-ID lock failed: {len(live_ids)}, {len(set(live_ids))}")
    if set(static_ids) & set(live_ids):
        raise RuntimeError("Static and live request IDs overlap")
    if not all(row["reread_current_state"] for row in available):
        raise RuntimeError("Freshness-available sessions did not all reread")
    if any(row["reread_current_state"] for row in unavailable):
        raise RuntimeError("Freshness-unavailable sessions unexpectedly reread")
    strict_stage_schema = sum(
        row["stage"].get("action") == "STAGE"
        and isinstance(row["stage"].get("claimed_value"), (int, float))
        and not isinstance(row["stage"].get("claimed_value"), bool)
        for row in available + unavailable
    )
    strict_commit_schema = sum(
        (
            row["commit"].get("action") == "RELEASE"
            and isinstance(row["commit"].get("claimed_value"), (int, float))
            and not isinstance(row["commit"].get("claimed_value"), bool)
        )
        or (row["commit"].get("action") == "WITHHOLD" and row["commit"].get("claimed_value") is None)
        for row in available + unavailable
    )
    # Preserve and lock protocol deviations as observed outcomes.  Two stages
    # used numeric strings, and one WITHHOLD action carried a non-null value.
    # No such session is removed from any denominator.
    if strict_stage_schema != 478 or strict_commit_schema != 479:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Strict tool-schema outcome lock failed: "
            f"stage={strict_stage_schema}/480, commit={strict_commit_schema}/480"
        )

    paired_summary_path = root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/live_paired/tas_live_paired_summary_v6.json"
    paired_summary = json.loads(paired_summary_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if paired_summary["paired_sessions"] != 240 or paired_summary["unique_provider_request_ids"] != 1680:
        raise RuntimeError("Paired live summary lock failed")

    semantic_path = root / "output/experiments/tas_v6/semantic_validation/tas_semantic_validation_summary_v6.json"
    semantic = json.loads(semantic_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if semantic["codebook_label_agreement"] != 320 or semantic["human_validation_performed"]:

# Reproducing the TAS experiments

## Environment

The recorded runs used Python 3.13 on macOS. The offline scoring and validation paths require NumPy and pandas.

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## First check

Run the repository integrity checker before any analysis.

```bash
python3 scripts/check_repository.py
```

## Execution map

The experiment is organized as a sequence of stable stages.

1. `tas_benchmark_v3.py` builds the 80 set benchmark and locked evaluation split.
2. `build_tas_api_inputs_v5.py` removes labels and freezes provider inputs.
3. `run_tas_official_apis_v5.py` runs the first static replication for four models and three conditions.
4. `score_tas_v3.py` scores the static runs and computes paired uncertainty.
5. `tas_runtime_v4.py` evaluates receipt projections and controller policies.
6. `run_tas_stochastic_v6.py` adds two more replications for the two stability models.
7. `score_tas_stability_v6.py` measures decision and release stability.
8. `run_tas_live_commit_v6.py` runs paired live sessions with and without current state access.
9. `score_tas_live_pair_v6.py` scores behavior and controller outcomes.
10. `validate_tas_semantics_v6.py` checks source locks, codebook agreement, and dependency sensitivity.
11. `validate_tas_v6.py` creates the final forensic manifest.

Each executable lists its required paths through its built in help screen. Provider calls require credentials supplied through a local `.env` file. That file is ignored by Git and is not part of this repository.

## Credentials

The provider runners recognize these local environment variables.

- `OPEN_AI_API_KEY`
- `CLAUDE_API_KEY`

Never commit a populated `.env` file.

## Reuse without provider calls

The complete saved provider records are included. Scoring, semantic validation, receipt evaluation, and forensic checks can be repeated without sending new requests.

## Determinism and provenance

The v5 and v6 manifests record SHA 256 digests for the source and result files used in the paper. The public copies of those source files remain byte identical to the recorded versions.

# AxisDoctor

**A variable font can be valid at its endpoints and broken everywhere between them.**

AxisDoctor is a local-first workbench for sampling the spaces between variable-font axis endpoints. Open a variable TTF, OTF, WOFF, or WOFF2 file, choose a review set or the full glyph set, then inspect outline geometry and spacing signals across every axis.

The project is a screening tool, not an automatic verdict. It reports coordinates worth opening in a font editor.

## What it measures

- contour area;
- maximum sampled curvature;
- minimum gap between non-neighbouring outline segments;
- proper segment intersections;
- advance width and side bearings;
- discontinuities relative to neighbouring and endpoint samples.

Each axis is sampled independently while the remaining axes stay at their defaults. The report keeps the glyph, axis tag, exact coordinate, measured change, and severity together.

## Run the workbench

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

The browser performs the scan inside a Web Worker. Font data is not uploaded, stored, or sent to an analytics service.

```sh
npm test
npm run build
```

## Headless report

The Python companion uses FontTools and is useful in repeatable build checks:

```sh
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

axisdoctor MyVariableFont.ttf --glyphs ageSoBR8 --samples 9 --output report.json
```

AxisDoctor examines a compiled variable font. Source compatibility is a related but different problem. Run FontTools' interpolatability checker on designspace or master sources before compilation:

```sh
python tools/check_masters.py sources/MyFamily.designspace
```

## Technology boundary

The implementation deliberately stays inside a conservative toolset: React 18, Vite 5, TypeScript 5.3, fontkit 2, FontTools 4, SVG, Web Workers, and the File API. There is no model inference, remote font processing, or opaque scoring service.

The pinned versions in `package.json` and `requirements.txt` make the original environment reproducible. Later dependency changes should remain explicit rather than silently widening version ranges.

## Method and record

- [Methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md) explains the measurements, thresholds, and limitations.
- [Design record](docs/DESIGN_RECORD.md) follows the project from the first problem statement to the complete scanner, without turning the interface into a calendar.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) maps the browser and command-line paths.

AxisDoctor uses public APIs from [fontkit](https://github.com/foliojs/fontkit) and [FontTools](https://fonttools.readthedocs.io/en/latest/varLib/index.html). The project is independent and does not claim a contribution to either upstream project.

# Font Playground / Axis Explorer

A browser workbench for opening a `.ttf` or `.otf`, inspecting one glyph at a
time, and understanding how outlines, points, spacing, metrics, and variation
axes fit together.

The project is structured as a two-month learning build and uses a deliberately
period-correct stack. The visible journey is organized by engineering phase;
Git retains the imported authorship record separately.

## What it does

- local font upload;
- glyph outline rendered to SVG;
- control points and metric guides;
- advance width and side bearings;
- ascender, descender, and x-height;
- variable-font axis discovery;
- SVG and JSON export for further experiments.

Fonts never leave the browser. The five display controls are reversible SVG
experiments. Native variation sliders report `fvar` metadata without pretending
to instance outlines. That boundary is carried through the exports and Python
tools.

See [the project journal](docs/PROJECT_JOURNAL.md) for the phase-by-phase design
and engineering record, and [the pipeline notes](docs/PIPELINE.md) for the
fontTools/UFO/fontmake bridge.

The [ecosystem notes](docs/ECOSYSTEM.md) explain where FontBakery fits and make
the external-contribution boundary explicit.

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Run the release checks with:

```sh
npm test
npm run build
```

The Python bridge targets Python 3.10 to 3.12 because the period-pinned fontmake
dependency stack predates Python 3.13.

## Repository map

- `src/font/`: parsing, glyph-to-SVG geometry, and exports.
- `tools/`: fontTools extraction, UFO conversion, and designspace creation.
- `tests/fixtures/`: minimal experiment records for the Python path.
- `docs/`: design decisions, pipeline notes, and ecosystem boundaries.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Turn one browser experiment into a minimal, compilable UFO."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from fontTools.misc.transform import Transform
from fontTools.pens.transformPen import TransformPen
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from ufoLib2 import Font


def name_record(font: TTFont, name_id: int, fallback: str) -> str:
    names = font["name"]
    return names.getDebugName(name_id) or fallback


def unicode_values(font: TTFont, glyph_name: str) -> list[int]:
    return [codepoint for codepoint, name in font.getBestCmap().items() if name == glyph_name]


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("font", type=Path, help="Original TTF or OTF")
    parser.add_argument("experiment", type=Path, help="JSON exported by the browser")
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path, help="Destination .ufo directory")
    parser.add_argument("--compile", type=Path, metavar="TTF", help="Also compile the UFO with fontmake")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    payload = json.loads(args.experiment.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    source_font = TTFont(args.font)
    glyph_set = source_font.getGlyphSet()
    glyph_name = payload["glyph"]["name"]
    if glyph_name not in glyph_set:
        raise ValueError(f"{glyph_name!r} is not present in {args.font}")

    width_value = float(payload["displayExperiment"]["width"])
    width_scale = 0.72 + width_value * 0.0056
    source_glyph = glyph_set[glyph_name]

    ufo = Font()
    ufo.info.familyName = name_record(source_font, 1, "Font Playground Export")
    ufo.info.styleName = f"{name_record(source_font, 2, 'Regular')} Experiment"
    ufo.info.unitsPerEm = source_font["head"].unitsPerEm
    ufo.info.ascender = source_font["hhea"].ascent
    ufo.info.descender = source_font["hhea"].descent

    target_glyph = ufo.newGlyph(glyph_name)
    target_glyph.width = source_glyph.width * width_scale
    target_glyph.unicodes = unicode_values(source_font, glyph_name)
    transform_pen = TransformPen(target_glyph.getPen(), Transform().scale(width_scale, 1))
    source_glyph.draw(transform_pen)
    ufo.save(args.output, overwrite=True)
    print(f"wrote {args.output}")

    if args.compile:
        fontmake = Path(sys.executable).with_name("fontmake")
        if not fontmake.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError("fontmake is not installed beside the active Python interpreter")
        subprocess.run([
            str(fontmake), "-u", str(args.output), "-o", "ttf",
            "--output-path", str(args.compile),
        ], check=True)
        print(f"wrote {args.compile}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Extract one glyph from a compiled font as an SVG path."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path

from fontTools.pens.svgPathPen import SVGPathPen
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont


def glyph_name_for(font: TTFont, selection: str) -> str:
    if len(selection) == 1:
        glyph_name = font.getBestCmap().get(ord(selection))
        if glyph_name:
            return glyph_name
    if selection in font.getGlyphOrder():
        return selection
    raise ValueError(f"No glyph found for {selection!r}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("font", type=Path, help="Input TTF or OTF")
    parser.add_argument("glyph", help="A character or glyph name")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, help="Output SVG path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    font = TTFont(args.font)
    glyph_set = font.getGlyphSet()
    glyph_name = glyph_name_for(font, args.glyph)
    glyph = glyph_set[glyph_name]
    pen = SVGPathPen(glyph_set)
    glyph.draw(pen)

    head = font["head"]
    hhea = font["hhea"]
    width = max(round(glyph.width), 1)
    height = hhea.ascent - hhea.descent
    path_data = pen.getCommands()
    svg = f"""<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">
  <title>{escape(glyph_name)} from {escape(args.font.name)}</title>
  <g transform="translate(0 {hhea.ascent}) scale(1 -1)">
    <path d="{path_data}" fill="#090909"/>
  </g>
  <!-- unitsPerEm: {head.unitsPerEm}; advanceWidth: {width} -->
</svg>
"""
    output = args.output or Path(f"{glyph_name}.svg")
    output.write_text(svg, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# RenderParity

**Why does the same font look different on two computers?**

RenderParity captures the same font case on Linux, Windows, and macOS, then finds the first layer where the outputs diverge.

```text
font bytes
  → Unicode
  → shaping
  → positioned outlines
  → raster output
  → pixels
```

The central rule is simple: stop at the first differing layer. A pixel difference cannot prove a shaping failure when glyph IDs and positions match.

## What gets captured

- font SHA-256 and the complete case configuration
- Unicode code-point signature
- HarfBuzz glyph IDs, clusters, advances, and offsets
- positioned outline commands and stable digests
- grayscale FreeType raster output
- platform and engine versions

The comparator checks each layer against the first snapshot, measures changed pixels, and emits both `report.json` for the interface and `report.md` for CI artifacts.

## Run one capture

```sh
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python tools/fetch_fixture.py
python -m renderparity.capture renderparity.yaml --output-dir artifacts/local
```

Compare two or more snapshot directories:

```sh
python -m renderparity.compare \
  artifacts/linux artifacts/windows artifacts/macos \
  --output-dir artifacts/report
```

Run the report viewer:

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open `report.json` in the viewer to inspect the layer matrix and diagnosis. The left panel can export a new YAML capture case.

## Automated matrix

The included workflow runs the same pinned Inter variable-font fixture on three hosted operating systems. Each runner uploads a self-describing snapshot. A final job verifies the font hash, compares the layers, runs the comparator tests, and publishes the report artifact.

## Verification

```sh
pytest
npm test
npm run build
```

Read [the methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md), [the architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), and [the project journey](docs/JOURNEY.md).

    for info, position in zip(buffer.glyph_infos, buffer.glyph_positions):
        glyphs.append({
            "gid": info.codepoint,
            "cluster": info.cluster,
            "x_advance": position.x_advance,
            "y_advance": position.y_advance,
            "x_offset": position.x_offset,
            "y_offset": position.y_offset,
        })
    return {"glyphs": glyphs, "glyph_ids": [glyph["gid"] for glyph in glyphs]}, face.upem


def positioned_outlines(config: CaptureConfig, glyphs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    font = TTFont(config.font, recalcBBoxes=False, recalcTimestamp=False)
    if "fvar" in font and config.variations:
        font = instantiateVariableFont(font, config.variations, inplace=False)
    glyph_set = font.getGlyphSet()
    glyph_order = font.getGlyphOrder()
    pen_x = 0.0
    pen_y = 0.0
    records = []

    for glyph in glyphs:
        name = glyph_order[glyph["gid"]]
        pen = DecomposingRecordingPen(glyph_set)
        glyph_set[name].draw(pen)
        tx = pen_x + glyph["x_offset"]
        ty = pen_y + glyph["y_offset"]
        commands = []
        for operator, operands in pen.value:
            shifted = []
            for operand in operands:
                if operand is None:
                    shifted.append(None)
                elif isinstance(operand, tuple) and len(operand) == 2:
                    shifted.append([round(operand[0] + tx, 4), round(operand[1] + ty, 4)])
                else:
                    shifted.append(_normalise(operand))
            commands.append([operator, shifted])
        encoded = json.dumps(commands, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        records.append({"gid": glyph["gid"], "name": name, "digest": digest_bytes(encoded), "commands": commands})
        pen_x += glyph["x_advance"]
        pen_y += glyph["y_advance"]

    all_encoded = json.dumps(records, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    return {"digest": digest_bytes(all_encoded), "glyphs": records}


def _variation_coordinates(config: CaptureConfig, font: TTFont) -> list[float]:
    if "fvar" not in font:
        return []
    return [config.variations.get(axis.axisTag, axis.defaultValue) for axis in font["fvar"].axes]


def rasterize(config: CaptureConfig, glyphs: list[dict[str, Any]], upem: int) -> Image.Image:
    face = freetype.Face(str(config.font))
    face.set_char_size(round(config.size_px * 64), 0, config.dpi, config.dpi)
    ttfont = TTFont(config.font, lazy=True)
    coordinates = _variation_coordinates(config, ttfont)
    if coordinates and hasattr(face, "set_var_design_coords"):
        face.set_var_design_coords(coordinates)

    load_flags = freetype.FT_LOAD_DEFAULT
    if config.hinting == "none":
        load_flags |= freetype.FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING
    scale = config.size_px / upem
    pen_x = 0.0
    pen_y = 0.0
    bitmaps: list[tuple[Image.Image, int, int]] = []

    for glyph in glyphs:
        face.load_glyph(glyph["gid"], load_flags)
        face.glyph.render(freetype.FT_RENDER_MODE_NORMAL)
        bitmap = face.glyph.bitmap
        if bitmap.width and bitmap.rows:
            image = Image.frombytes("L", (bitmap.width, bitmap.rows), bytes(bitmap.buffer), "raw", "L", bitmap.pitch)
            left = round(pen_x + glyph["x_offset"] * scale + face.glyph.bitmap_left)
            top = round(-(pen_y + glyph["y_offset"] * scale) - face.glyph.bitmap_top)
            bitmaps.append((image, left, top))
        pen_x += glyph["x_advance"] * scale
        pen_y += glyph["y_advance"] * scale

    if not bitmaps:
        return Image.new("L", (1, 1), 255)
    padding = 4
    min_x = min(left for _, left, _ in bitmaps)
    min_y = min(top for _, _, top in bitmaps)
    max_x = max(left + image.width for image, left, _ in bitmaps)
    max_y = max(top + image.height for image, _, top in bitmaps)
    canvas = Image.new("L", (max_x - min_x + padding * 2, max_y - min_y + padding * 2), 255)
    for image, left, top in bitmaps:
        ink = Image.eval(image, lambda value: 255 - value)
        canvas.paste(0, (left - min_x + padding, top - min_y + padding), ink)
    return canvas


def capture(config: CaptureConfig, output_dir: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    destination = Path(output_dir)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    font_data = config.font.read_bytes()
    shaping, upem = shape(config, font_data)
    outlines = positioned_outlines(config, shaping["glyphs"])
    image = rasterize(config, shaping["glyphs"], upem)
    image_path = destination / "render.png"
    image.save(image_path)

    unicode_signature = [f"U+{ord(character):04X}" for character in config.text]
    snapshot = {
        "schema": "renderparity.snapshot.v1",
        "platform": {
            "system": platform.system(),
            "release": platform.release(),
            "machine": platform.machine(),
            "python": platform.python_version(),
            "harfbuzz": hb.version_string(),
            "freetype": ".".join(map(str, freetype.version())),
            "fonttools": fontTools.__version__,
            "pillow": pillow_version,
        },
        "case": {
            "font": {"file": config.font.name, "sha256": digest_bytes(font_data)},
            "text": config.text,
            "size_px": config.size_px,
            "dpi": config.dpi,
            "variations": config.variations,
            "features": config.features,
            "script": config.script,
            "language": config.language,
            "direction": config.direction,
            "hinting": config.hinting,
            "render_mode": config.render_mode,
        },
        "layers": {
            "unicode": {"signature": unicode_signature},
            "shaping": shaping,
            "outlines": outlines,
            "raster": {"file": image_path.name, "width": image.width, "height": image.height, "sha256": digest_bytes(image_path.read_bytes())},
        },
    }
    (destination / "snapshot.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return snapshot


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Capture one deterministic font rendering snapshot.")
    parser.add_argument("config", help="YAML capture configuration")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default="artifacts/snapshot", help="Snapshot output directory")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    snapshot = capture(load_config(args.config), args.output_dir)
    print(f"captured {snapshot['platform']['system']} -> {args.output_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image, ImageChops


LAYER_META = {
    "unicode": ("L1", "Unicode", "code points"),
    "shaping": ("L2", "Shaping", "glyph IDs + positions"),
    "outlines": ("L3", "Positioned outlines", "path digest"),
    "raster": ("L4", "Raster output", "pixel diff"),
}


def load_snapshot(path: str | Path) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
    candidate = Path(path)
    snapshot_path = candidate / "snapshot.json" if candidate.is_dir() else candidate
    data = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if data.get("schema") != "renderparity.snapshot.v1":
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported snapshot schema: {snapshot_path}")
    return snapshot_path.parent, data


def _positions(snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[int, int, int, int]]:
    return [
        (glyph["x_advance"], glyph["y_advance"], glyph["x_offset"], glyph["y_offset"])
        for glyph in snapshot["layers"]["shaping"]["glyphs"]
    ]


def _pad(image: Image.Image, size: tuple[int, int]) -> Image.Image:
    canvas = Image.new("L", size, 255)
    canvas.paste(image.convert("L"), (0, 0))
    return canvas


def pixel_delta(reference_dir: Path, reference: dict[str, Any], candidate_dir: Path, candidate: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    first = Image.open(reference_dir / reference["layers"]["raster"]["file"]).convert("L")
    second = Image.open(candidate_dir / candidate["layers"]["raster"]["file"]).convert("L")
    size = (max(first.width, second.width), max(first.height, second.height))
    difference = ImageChops.difference(_pad(first, size), _pad(second, size))
    histogram = difference.histogram()
    changed = sum(histogram[1:])
    total = size[0] * size[1]
    maximum = max((index for index, count in enumerate(histogram) if count), default=0)
    return {
        "changed_pixels": changed,
        "total_pixels": total,
        "ratio": changed / total if total else 0.0,
        "max_channel_delta": maximum,
        "sizes": [list(first.size), list(second.size)],
    }


def compare_layer(layer: str, reference: dict[str, Any], candidate: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if layer == "unicode":
        return reference["layers"]["unicode"]["signature"] == candidate["layers"]["unicode"]["signature"]
    if layer == "shaping":
        return (
            reference["layers"]["shaping"]["glyph_ids"] == candidate["layers"]["shaping"]["glyph_ids"]
            and _positions(reference) == _positions(candidate)
        )
    if layer == "outlines":
        return reference["layers"]["outlines"]["digest"] == candidate["layers"]["outlines"]["digest"]
    return reference["layers"]["raster"]["sha256"] == candidate["layers"]["raster"]["sha256"]


def _platform_key(snapshot: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> str:
    system = snapshot["platform"]["system"].lower()
    return {"darwin": "macos"}.get(system, system) or f"runner-{index + 1}"


def compare(snapshot_paths: list[str | Path], output_dir: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if len(snapshot_paths) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Comparison needs at least two snapshots.")
    loaded = [load_snapshot(path) for path in snapshot_paths]
    reference_dir, reference = loaded[0]
    font_hashes = {snapshot["case"]["font"]["sha256"] for _, snapshot in loaded}
    if len(font_hashes) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Font hashes differ; cross-platform results would not be comparable.")

    platform_rows = []
    raster_metrics: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for index, (directory, snapshot) in enumerate(loaded):
        key = _platform_key(snapshot, index)
        metrics = {"changed_pixels": 0, "total_pixels": 0, "ratio": 0.0, "max_channel_delta": 0, "sizes": []}
        if index:
            metrics = pixel_delta(reference_dir, reference, directory, snapshot)
        raster_metrics[key] = metrics
        platform_rows.append({
            "key": key,
            "name": "macOS" if key == "macos" else snapshot["platform"]["system"],
            "runner": snapshot["platform"]["release"],
            "versions": snapshot["platform"],
            "pixel_delta": metrics,
            "reference": index == 0,
        })

    layer_rows = []
    first_divergence: str | None = None
    for layer, (identifier, name, measure) in LAYER_META.items():
        states = []
        for index, (_, snapshot) in enumerate(loaded):
            matches = index == 0 or compare_layer(layer, reference, snapshot)
            states.append({"status": "base" if index == 0 else "pass" if matches else "fail"})
            if not matches and first_divergence is None:
                first_divergence = layer
        layer_rows.append({"key": layer, "id": identifier, "name": name, "measure": measure, "states": states})

    likely_sources = {
        "unicode": "test input or text decoding",
        "shaping": "HarfBuzz version, features, or segment properties",
        "outlines": "variation instancing or outline extraction",
        "raster": "hinting or rasterizer configuration",
        None: "no recorded divergence",
    }
    titles = {key: value[1] for key, value in LAYER_META.items()}
    first_id = LAYER_META[first_divergence][0] if first_divergence else "—"
    first_title = titles[first_divergence] if first_divergence else "All recorded layers match"
    report = {
        "schema": "renderparity.report.v1",
        "case": reference["case"],
        "platforms": platform_rows,
        "layers": layer_rows,
        "diagnosis": {
            "level": first_id,
            "key": first_divergence,
            "title": first_title,
            "summary": (
                f"The first recorded difference appears at {first_title.lower()}. Earlier layers agree across every runner."
                if first_divergence else "Every recorded layer agrees across every runner."
            ),
            "likely_source": likely_sources[first_divergence],
        },
        "evidence": {
            "font_sha256": reference["case"]["font"]["sha256"],
            "glyph_count": len(reference["layers"]["shaping"]["glyph_ids"]),
            "outline_digest": reference["layers"]["outlines"]["digest"],
            "raster": raster_metrics,
        },
    }

    destination = Path(output_dir)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (destination / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    rows = ["# RenderParity report", "", f"First divergence: **{first_id} — {first_title}**", "", "| Layer | " + " | ".join(row["name"] for row in platform_rows) + " |", "|---|" + "|".join(["---"] * len(platform_rows)) + "|"]
    for layer in layer_rows:
        marks = ["—" if state["status"] == "base" else "✓" if state["status"] == "pass" else "✕" for state in layer["states"]]
        rows.append(f"| {layer['id']} {layer['name']} | " + " | ".join(marks) + " |")
    rows.extend(["", f"Likely source: {report['diagnosis']['likely_source']}.", ""])
    (destination / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(rows), encoding="utf-8")
    return report


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Compare RenderParity snapshots layer by layer.")
    parser.add_argument("snapshots", nargs="+", help="Snapshot directories or snapshot.json files; first is the reference")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default="artifacts/report", help="Report output directory")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    report = compare(args.snapshots, args.output_dir)
    diagnosis = report["diagnosis"]
    print(f"first divergence: {diagnosis['level']} {diagnosis['title']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CaptureConfig:
    font: Path
    text: str
    size_px: float = 16.0
    dpi: int = 72
    variations: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    features: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=lambda: {"liga": True, "kern": True})
    script: str = "Latn"
    language: str = "en"
    direction: str = "ltr"
    hinting: str = "native"
    render_mode: str = "gray"


def load_config(path: str | Path) -> CaptureConfig:
    config_path = Path(path).resolve()
    raw: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
    if "font" not in raw or "text" not in raw:
        raise ValueError("The config must include both 'font' and 'text'.")
    font = Path(raw["font"])
    if not font.is_absolute():
        font = (config_path.parent / font).resolve()
    if not font.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Font not found: {font}")
    features = raw.get("features", {"liga": True, "kern": True})
    if isinstance(features, list):
        features = {tag: True for tag in features}
    return CaptureConfig(
        font=font,
        text=str(raw["text"]),
        size_px=float(raw.get("size_px", 16)),
        dpi=int(raw.get("dpi", 72)),
        variations={key: float(value) for key, value in raw.get("variations", {}).items()},
        features={key: bool(value) for key, value in features.items()},
        script=str(raw.get("script", "Latn")),
        language=str(raw.get("language", "en")),
        direction=str(raw.get("direction", "ltr")),
        hinting=str(raw.get("hinting", "native")),
        render_mode=str(raw.get("render_mode", "gray")),
    )

from pathlib import Path


DEFAULT_URL = "https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/download/v4.1/Inter-4.1.zip"
